## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds capability)
- [ ] Breaking change (existing behavior changes)
- [ ] New or improved loop (`loops/`)
- [ ] Docs only (README / LOOP.md / others)
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup (no behavior change)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally (runs the built-in `node --test` suite — no deps to install).
- [ ] **Zero new runtime dependencies** — Node >= 18 builtins only, ESM, Windows + POSIX friendly.
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed — **LOOP.md** is the source of truth; README / config examples updated to match.
- [ ] **No screenshots in this PR or the public repo** — screenshots live only in the private image repo, never in git history here.
